name: Phantom Armor Tetra ~Saishuu Kessen! Sei ka Shi ka?! Aieki Midaretobu Nikugoku no Kanata e...~
original_name: 霊甲テトラ～最終決戦ッ！生か死か？！愛液乱れ飛ぶ肉獄の彼方へ……～
source:
Tetra entered the nest of Glams with Lebianna to save Neon. As expected, traps awaited her.
3 girls ended up restraint, and the final battle started!

3名少女最终悉数遭到拘束，最终决战就此拉开帷幕！
